items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL and not expected to play Sunday vs DEN (hip/groin); Rapoport/Schefter corroborate not expected, with Davante Adams to carry the load as seen in prior absence (195 yds/2 TD).
items.why: No practice all week; McVay not optimistic, expected back Week 4 barring setback.
items.implication: Adams elevated to high-end WR1; possible TE streamer upside in Ferguson/Whittington.

items.text: Jayden Daniels officially OUT Sunday; Rapoport notes positive longer-term news (no surgery expected, week-to-week) but Marcus Mariota starts. McLaurin has solid historical target share with Mariota.
items.implication: McLaurin still viable but tougher SEA matchup; lower team total.
items.opportunity: Mariota game script may still feed McLaurin.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe); Steelers RB coach says Jaylen Warren will lead the group with breathers as needed. Levitan expects checkdown spam for Warren given vertical game struggles; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.why: Toe injury; official out, coach comments on rotation.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back/RB2+ with receiving work.
items.opportunity: Warren carries, checkdowns, snaps expand heavily.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT Sunday at IND (hamstring); ETR lists him OUT. Dalton Schultz saw 30% target rate/28% share in prior absence.
items.implication: Schultz TE1 upside vs Colts (4th-most TE yards allowed).

items.text: Levitan/ETR projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags; seeking early clarity on Zay Flowers (hamstring), AD Mitchell, DJ Moore.
items.why: Practice indicators and internal projections; LP/full enough.
items.implication: Start with confidence if no late change; Flowers more uncertain.

items.text: Travis Etienne and Malik Nabers listed IN for Sunday; Etienne LP but expected, Nabers cleared.
items.implication: Full or near-full roles; Etienne still shared.

items.text: Levitan notes Jahmyr Gibbs set new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate vs Jets at home; heavy early workload.
items.implication: Elite RB1 with massive upside in all formats/DFS.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and ACTIVE/good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle). ETR lists both IN.
items.implication: Committee returns; reverse any Coleman-only beneficiaries.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks to IR (core muscle, 6-8 weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5), DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Volume and YPC vs weak front.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games, RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry LOVES Chris Olave (vs LV, double-digit tgts/air yards), Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% share sans Collins + TE D), Christian Watson (vs ATL, WR8 util/RZ share).
items.opportunity: Olave volume, Schultz TE1, Watson RZ.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara), Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble + tough run D), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest FP to WRs, low team total).
items.implication: Sit or fade in favor of better options.
items.opportunity: Henderson rising post-Stevenson fumble (Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead slightly).
items.conflict: ETR has Etienne IN but role may remain limited.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched Stevenson 16-5 post-fumble (gap narrowing but Stevenson still ranked ahead); Drake London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds avg with Penix; Schultz 30% route targets sans Collins.
items.why: Concrete snap/target/share data from recent games.
items.implication: Monitor Henderson closely; London smash with Penix; Schultz stream.
items.opportunity: Henderson role growth; London target monopoly; Schultz TE volume.
